audit.summary: Three supported local defects: interaction-only cost presented as full complexity, incomplete WUF state recurrence, and incorrect CN ablation percentage. Core displayed rankings and fixed-width linear input scaling survive inspected checks. Practical efficiency and implementation need evidence.
limitations: P1 — Full cost expression omits width-quadratic dense-layer costs — Counterevidence: Attention-only expression and fixed-width linear N scaling survive; p23 acknowledges higher cost/shrinking gap; no demonstrated dependency of Figure4 error curve on cost derivation. No categorical cheaper-than-FNO crossover attributed.

P2 — WUF pseudocode lacks state updates and valid remainder input — Counterevidence: Main text and Figure3 explicitly specify feedback of predicted horizon state. No code or empirical evidence of future-target leakage or erroneous forecasts.
P3 — CN ablation degradation percentage inconsistent with rounded errors — Counterevidence: Direction and ranking unchanged; no larger empirical consequence established.
Limitations: No implementation archive staged; original PDF plus official/author HTML only.
